correctness.rationale: For even n, the exact odd-unit nth powers are 1+2^(v2(n)+2)Z2 by 2-adic logarithm. Comparing v2(x),v2(y) gives exactly the three value families 2^(nv)(1+qZ2), 2^(nv)(c+qZ2), 2^(nv)(1+c+qZ2), including zero. In nonsplit case d=v2(1+c)<h these are cosets with fixed valuations; dividing the nested unit subgroups yields precisely the nine balls and valuation classes, and local finiteness on nonzero annuli plus zero establishes closedness. In split case odd root of X^n+c gives simple-zero quotient-density. Nonnegative integers are dense in Z2. Independent modular direct enumeration matched 126 normalized image profiles; no inference of all-adic truth from finite residue tests.
